title: 第6章 叶凛：接受礼物不等于我同意，来自前辈的经验
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 这两行字发出去没过两秒，手机屏幕顶端的状态栏瞬间变成了“对方正在输入中……”。紧接着又变成名字，然后又是“正在输入中……”。夏晚晴把脑袋凑得更近了些，那双杏眼瞪得溜圆，嘴里的饺子都忘了嚼。“嗡——”手机猛地一震，一条长达六十秒的语音方阵杀气腾腾地砸了过来。叶凛面不改色，食指轻点。“叶凛你还是不是个男人？！”秦菲菲那尖锐的声音瞬间炸响。分贝之高，差点把手机扬声器给震劈了。“上个月七号！XX酒店302！”“那天晚上吃的饭你没拒绝吧？订的房间你也来了吧？我暗示你你也听懂了吧？该做的你都做了吧？”“现在你跟我说没同意？穿上裤子就不认账是吧？！”“噗——咳咳咳咳！”夏晚晴这次是真的喷了。半个饺子皮直接飞到了茶几上。她整个人像只被踩了尾巴的猫一样从沙发上弹起来，一只手捂着胸口疯狂咳嗽，另一只手颤颤巍巍地指着叶凛的鼻子。“老叶！你……你你你……”她那张小麦色的脸涨得通红，不知是呛的还是急的。“你居然真把她……？！”叶凛淡定地抽了一张纸巾，擦掉溅到手背上的一点唾沫星子，顺手把那半个饺子皮扫进垃圾桶。他拿起手机，按下语音键。“纠正一下。”“那天是你约的我，房费是你付的。”松开手指，发送。他继续按住语音键，看向一脸呆滞的夏晚晴，耸了耸肩：“我一没出钱，二没出力……哦，力还是出了一点的。”“但这能怪我吗？”夏晚晴感觉自已的脑子有点不够用了。她一屁股坐回沙发，抓了抓那头乱糟糟的短发，试图理清这个逻辑：“不是……这跟你同不同意做她男朋友有什么关系？”“既然睡了，那不就是……”“当然没关系。”叶凛打断了她，理直气壮地摊开手。“你想想，一个身高170，体重95斤，42D，还穿着巴黎世家的大美女，哭着喊着要把自已送给你。”“连房费都付了，还得给你转账让你打车去，附带一顿价值上万的烛光晚餐。”“这种情况下，我要是拒绝，那不仅是不礼貌，更是对我生理机能的一种侮辱。”“我又不是太监，为什么要搞柳下惠那一套？”夏晚晴张了张嘴，想反驳。却发现自已竟然找不到切入点。难怪那天叶凛给她打包了那么好吃的海鲜呢。光顾着吃了，忘记问了。“可是……”她憋了半天，憋出一句，“那也不能随便睡啊！”“谁随便了？”叶凛指了指手机屏幕上的转账记录，“我当时以为那是她送我的‘表白礼物’。”“既然是礼物，那我收下不是很正常吗？”“就好比有人送你一张限量版的显卡，你收了。”“但这代表你要跟送显卡的人结婚吗？”夏晚晴下意识地摇头：“那肯定不行。”“那不就结了。”叶凛一拍大腿。“接受礼物不等于我同意。”“这可是我老家的前辈们的经验啊！”夏晚晴看着叶凛那张写满“正义”的脸，只觉得三观正在经历一场八级大地震。这逻辑……虽然听起来像是在放屁。但仔细一想，竟然该死的通顺！这就是传说中的渣得明明白白吗？随着叶凛松开语音键，手机再次震动。【秦菲菲：？？？？？？】【秦菲菲：叶凛，你是不是疯了？这种话你也说得出口？】【秦菲菲：我们要是不算男女朋友，那算什么？跑友吗？！】叶凛低头打字。【叶凛：怎么能说得这么难听？我们这叫“基于双方自愿原则下的短期深度交流合作伙伴”。】【叶凛：而且，你确实没要求我当你男朋友啊。】【叶凛：现在问题来了，既然我从未口头答应过做你男朋友，那你这个“分手”的操作是不成立的。】【叶凛：你这属于单方面宣布解除一个根本不存在的契约。】手机那头。市中心某高档公寓内。秦菲菲穿着真丝睡袍，手里端着一杯红酒，原本精致的妆容此刻有些扭曲。她死死盯着屏幕上的字，胸口剧烈起伏。“混蛋！神经病！”她把高脚杯重重地顿在茶几上，红酒洒出来染红了白色的羊毛地毯。这个叶凛，以前不是挺老实的吗？给他钱就要。怎么突然变得这么……这么有病？但转念一想，秦菲菲又觉得哪里不对。这男人以前对自已百依百顺，随叫随到。现在突然变得这么尖酸刻薄，甚至还要强行否认两人的关系……“呵。”秦菲菲突然冷笑了一声，紧皱的眉头舒展开来，脸上重新浮现出那种高高在上的优越感。她懂了。这男人是在闹别扭。也是，自已现在是天之骄女，被王家大少看中，前途无量。而他叶凛，依旧是个连房租都交不起的穷光蛋。这种巨大的落差感，肯定让他那可怜的自尊心受不了了。他否认关系，不是因为不在乎，恰恰是因为太在乎！他不想承认自已是被甩的那一个，所以才编出这种可笑的理由，想要保留最后一点颜面。“真是个可怜的男人。”秦菲菲看着手机，眼中闪过一丝怜悯和不屑。既然你想演，那本小姐就陪你演完这最后一场戏。毕竟，王少那边还需要自已有个“清白”的过去。如果能让叶凛闭嘴，不让他到处乱说，配合他演一下也无妨。而且如果叶凛真挺在乎她的，以后和王少在一起的时候，把叶凛养着也无所谓。【秦菲菲：行了，我知道你心里难受。】【秦菲菲：你不就是想要点面子吗？我懂。】出租屋内。叶凛看着这两条消息，挑了挑眉。这女人，脑补能力还是一如既往的强啊。这就“懂”了？他也不解释，顺水推舟地回了一句。【叶凛：既然你懂，那咱们就别搞得那么难看。】【叶凛：我这人脸皮薄，被人甩了传出去不好听。】【叶凛：要不这样，我们补个流程。】夏晚晴此时已经彻底放弃了思考。她抱着抱枕缩在沙发角落里，像看外星人一样看着叶凛操作。“你又要干嘛？”她忍不住问。“搞点节目效果。”叶凛头也不抬。【秦菲菲：什么流程？】【叶凛：你现在，正式给我发一段表白的小作文。】【叶凛：要真情实感，要感人肺腑，最好能回顾一下我们这段时间的点点滴滴。】【叶凛：然后，我回复“同意”，这样我们就正式确立关系了。】【叶凛：确立关系之后，你再提分手。】【叶凛：这样你就不是甩了一个“路人”，而是甩了你的“正牌男友”。】这一套组合拳打出去，连旁边的夏晚晴都看傻了。“老叶……”夏晚晴咽了口唾沫，眼神复杂。“你这脑子到底是怎么长的？这种损招你都想得出来？”让人家先表白，再同意，再让人家甩？这不就是脱裤子放屁吗？但秦菲菲显然不这么想。在她看来，这是叶凛最后的倔强。他想要一个“名分”，哪怕这个名分只有几秒钟。多么卑微的爱啊。秦菲菲看着屏幕，心中那股虚荣感得到了极大的满足。看吧，即便自已都要跟别人跑了，这个男人还是对自已念念不忘，甚至还要用这种方式来骗自已。【秦菲菲：行吧，看在你跟了我这么久的份上，我就满足你这个小小的愿望。】【秦菲菲：等着。】
content_en: Within two seconds after these two lines of text were sent out, the status bar at the top of the phone screen instantly changed to "The other party is typing...".Then it changed to the name, and then "Entering...".Xia Wanqing moved her head closer, her almond-shaped eyes widened, and she even forgot to chew the dumplings in her mouth."Buzz--" The phone vibrated suddenly, and a sixty-second voice square came over with murderous intent.Ye Lin's face didn't change and he tapped his index finger lightly."Ye Lin, are you still a man?!" Qin Feifei's sharp voice exploded instantly.The decibel level was so high that it almost knocked out the phone speaker."On the 7th of last month! XX Hotel 302!" "You didn't refuse the meal that night, did you? Did you come to book the room? Did you understand my hint? You did everything you had to do, right?" "Now you tell me that you don't agree? You don't admit it when you put on your pants, right?!" "Pfft - cough cough cough cough!" Xia Wanqing really sprayed this time.Half of the dumpling skin flew directly to the coffee table.She jumped up from the sofa like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, covering her chest with one hand and coughing wildly, while the other hand pointed tremblingly at Ye Lin's nose."Lao Ye! You... you you you..." Her wheat-colored face turned red, whether from choking or anxiety."You actually really...?!" Ye Lin calmly took out a paper towel, wiped away a little bit of saliva that splashed on the back of his hand, and swept the half of the dumpling wrapper into the trash can.He picked up the phone and pressed the voice button."Correction." "You made an appointment with me that day, and you paid for the room." Release your finger and send.He continued to hold down the voice button, looked at Xia Wanqing, who looked dull, and shrugged: "I didn't contribute any money, and I didn't contribute any effort... Oh, I still contributed a little." "But can you blame me?" Xia Wanqing felt that her brain was a little insufficient.She sat back on the sofa and scratched her messy short hair, trying to clarify the logic: "No... what does this have to do with whether you agree to be her boyfriend or not?" "Since she's asleep, doesn't it mean..." "Of course it doesn't matter." Ye Lin interrupted her and spread out his hands confidently."Think about it, a beautiful woman who is 170cm tall, weighs 95kg, 42D, and is wearing Balenciaga, is crying and shouting that she wants to give herself to you." "I even paid for the room, and I have to transfer money to you to take a taxi, with a meal worth tens of thousands."Candlelight dinner.""In this case, if I refuse, it will not only be impolite, but also an insult to my physiological functions.""I'm not a eunuch, why do I do what Liu Xiahui did?"Xia Wanqing opened her mouth and wanted to refute.But I found that I couldn't find an entry point.No wonder Ye Lin packed such delicious seafood for her that day.I was busy eating and forgot to ask."But..." She held it in for a long time and then said, "You can't just sleep casually!" "Who did it casually?" Ye Lin pointed at the transfer record on the screen of the mobile phone, "I thought it was a 'confession gift' she gave me." "Since it is a gift, then I accept it.Isn't it normal?" "It's like someone gave you a limited edition graphics card and you accepted it." "But does that mean you want to marry the person who gave it to you?" Xia Wanqing shook her head subconsciously. "That's not the case." Ye Lin slapped her thigh."Accepting a gift does not mean that I agree." "This is the experience of my predecessors in my hometown!" Xia Wanqing looked at Ye Lin's face with "justice" written all over it, and felt that the world was experiencing an eight-magnitude earthquake.This logic... although it sounds like fart.But when I think about it carefully, it turns out to be damn smooth!Is this the legendary scumbag De Mingbai?As Ye Lin released the voice button, the phone vibrated again.[Qin Feifei:??????】【Qin Feifei: Ye Lin, are you crazy?Can you say this?】【Qin Feifei: If we are not boyfriend and girlfriend, then what are we?A runner?!] Ye Lin lowered his head and typed.[Ye Lin: How can you say it so harshly?We call this a "short-term in-depth exchange partnership based on the principle of mutual consent".】【Ye Lin: Moreover, you did not ask me to be your boyfriend.】【Ye Lin: Now here comes the problem. Since I never verbally agreed to be your boyfriend, your "breakup" operation is not valid.】【Ye Lin: You are unilaterally announcing the termination of a contract that does not exist at all.】The other end of the mobile phone.In a high-end apartment in the city center.Qin Feifei was wearing a silk nightgown and holding a glass of red wine in her hand. Her originally exquisite makeup was a little distorted at the moment.She stared at the words on the screen, her chest rising and falling violently."Asshole! Psycho!" She slammed the goblet on the coffee table, and the red wine spilled out and dyed the white wool carpet red.Wasn't this Ye Lin quite honest before?Just give him money.Why did you suddenly become so... so sick?But on second thought, Qin Feifei felt something was wrong.This man used to be obedient to him and always available to him.Now he suddenly became so bitter and mean, and even had to forcefully deny the relationship between the two... "Ha." Qin Feifei suddenly sneered, her frowning eyebrows unfurled, and the sense of superiority reappeared on her face.She got it.This man is causing trouble.Also, she is now a proud daughter of heaven, favored by the eldest son of the Wang family, and has a bright future.And he, Ye Lin, is still a pauper who can't even pay the rent.This huge sense of gap must have been unbearable for his poor self-esteem.He denies the relationship not because he doesn’t care, but precisely because he cares too much!He didn't want to admit that he was the one who was dumped, so he made up this ridiculous reason to save the last bit of face."What a pitiful man." Qin Feifei looked at the phone, a trace of pity and disdain flashing in her eyes.Since you want to act, I will accompany you through this last scene.After all, Mr. Wang still needs to have a "clean" past.If you can make Ye Lin shut up and stop him from talking nonsense, it won't hurt to cooperate with him in acting.And if Ye Lin really cares about her, it doesn't matter if she takes care of Ye Lin when she is with Mr. Wang in the future.[Qin Feifei: Okay, I know you feel uncomfortable.】【Qin Feifei: Don't you just want to save some face?I understand.】In a rental house.Ye Lin looked at these two messages and raised his eyebrows.This woman's brainstorming ability is still as strong as ever.Does this “get it”?He didn't explain, and just replied casually.[Ye Lin: Since you understand, let’s not make it so ugly.】【Ye Lin: I am a thin-skinned person, and it would not sound good if someone dumped me.】【Ye Lin: Otherwise, we will make up the process.】Xia Wanqing had completely given up thinking at this time.She hugged the pillow and huddled in the corner of the sofa, watching Ye Lin operate like an alien."What do you want to do again?" she couldn't help but ask."Make some show effects." Ye Lin didn't even raise his head.[Qin Feifei: What is the process?】【Ye Lin: Now, please formally send me a short confessional essay.】【Ye Lin: To be truly emotional and touching, it’s best to look back on every detail of our time together.】【Ye Lin: Then, I replied "agree", so that our relationship was officially established.】【Ye Lin: After the relationship is established, you can break up again.】【Ye Lin: In this way, you are not dumping a "passer-by", but your "real boyfriend".] This combination of punches made even Xia Wanqing next to her look dumbfounded."Old Ye..." Xia Wanqing swallowed, her eyes complex."How on earth do you have such a brain? You can even think of such a harmful move?" Let people confess your love first, then agree, and then let them dump you?Isn't this just taking off your pants and farting?But Qin Feifei obviously didn't think so.In her opinion, this was Ye Lin's last stubbornness.He wants a "status", even if it is only for a few seconds.What a humble love.Qin Feifei looked at the screen, and the vanity in her heart was greatly satisfied.Look, even if he is about to run away with someone else, this man still misses him, and even uses this method to deceive himself.[Qin Feifei: Okay, since you have been with me for so long, I will grant your little wish.】【Qin Feifei: Wait.】
